hero_subhead: The .LLab Journal™ is the intellectual-property and thought-leadership layer of The Co.LLab™ ecosystem — where R.A.T.™ research becomes frameworks, and frameworks become .LLab™ products, membership, and enterprise relationships.
teaser_body: An invitation-curated collection — the people who do the work. Craftspeople, tradespeople, makers: those who have mastered what they do and thought carefully about what it means to leave it behind. Access will be limited. This is not for everyone.
subscribe_body: Volume One is available now to subscribers — three essays on stewardship, systems, and succession, with new entries added as the curated collection grows.
